edition.title: This weekend on Keowee + Jocassee
edition.dek: No headline show at Walhalla PAC this week — their next one isn't until the 11th — so Jazz on the Alley carries Thursday, and Jocassee Valley Brewing stacks a food truck and a live band every night from Friday through Sunday. The weekly Jocassee sunset run still goes out Saturday evening.

events.title: Jazz on the Alley
events.body: Seneca's Thursday-night institution — free live jazz on historic Ram Cat Alley, every week through October. The happy-hour set starts at 5:30, the main act at 6:30. Get dinner downtown and let the weekend start a day early.
events.note: Free · 6:30–9pm (happy hour 5:30) · Ram Cat Alley, downtown Seneca

events.title: Sunset Lake Tour
events.body: A slower two-hour run out onto Jocassee as the light goes gold over the mountains, with a waterfall or two along the way. Runs every Saturday evening through the season.
events.note: $65 · 2 hours · every Saturday · Jocassee Lake Tours

events.title: Three nights of live music at Jocassee Valley
events.body: Jocassee Valley Brewing in Salem has its lineup posted: Kodesh BBQ & Bowls and According to Taste on Friday, Squeals on Wheels with Finkelstein Three on Saturday, and Farm to Fire pizza with Suze Luna & Dick Wells closing it out Sunday afternoon. Keowee Brewing in Seneca runs its usual free Friday and Saturday music too — check its calendar for who's on.
events.note: Free · sets start 6:30pm Fri & Sat, 4pm Sun at Jocassee Valley · Keowee Brewing Fri & Sat, lineup on their calendar

plan.title: Dinner, then live music at both breweries
plan.body: Jocassee Valley Brewing opens with Kodesh BBQ & Bowls and According to Taste at 6:30, while Keowee Brewing runs its usual free Friday set downtown. Grab a table at either before the sets fill in.
plan.label: Find a spot to eat & drink →

plan.title: A ramp, a swim, then the sunset tour
plan.body: No headline event Saturday during the day — find a ramp, get on the water, then book the Jocassee sunset run for the evening.
plan.label: Find a ramp →

plan.title: Keep it slow, then close it out at Jocassee Valley
plan.body: Pick a swim spot or check today's lake level, then wind down with Suze Luna & Dick Wells at 4pm and Farm to Fire pizza back at Jocassee Valley Brewing.
plan.label: Pick a swim spot →
